title: Looking Closely at a Bean Leaf

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Shh, look! There are little visitors on our bean leaves. Here is my magnifying glass.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Move it over the leaf to see up close. Then we'll write down what we notice, like real scientists.

questions.ask: How many spots does the ladybird have?
How many legs does the ant have?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Move the magnifying glass to look closely.

questions.ask: How many spots does the ladybird have?

feedback.all_good: Look at your notebook page! You noticed things most people walk right past.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Every little creature is made with such care. Ladybirds help our beans, too: they eat the tiny bugs that nibble the leaves.

journal_line: I looked closely at a bean leaf with a magnifying glass, counted what I saw, and wrote it in my nature notebook.
